ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white to low-intensity black pixel ratio approximately 9:1; the ventral surface is dominated by high-luminance pixels with a thin perimeter of low-luminance pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous high-intensity white field. Low-intensity black geometric banding is mapped continuously along the trailing edge and concentrated into dense focal blobs at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 115 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; notably higher amplitude 'peaks' observed on the distal third of the left lobe and mid-section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a gentle S-curve, transitioning from slight concavity near the median notch to a broader convexity toward the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters at both fluke tips; the left tip exhibits a more complex, irregular cluster geometry compared to the right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged contour on the right lobe's trailing edge suggesting prior physical wear or tissue loss compared to the smoother sections of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Remarkably high-purity white ventral pigmentation with nearly zero central mottling, resulting in a stark 'negative space' appearance against the water.
